mapping.draft_py:
keywords = [
    KeywordAbility(
        keyword=Keyword.HEXPROOF,
        params=(FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Instant'),),
    ),
    KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.LIFELINK),
]
abilities = [
    # [0] "As long as" is the StaticAbility's condition (D22; M11 Serra Ascendant's verified B14-as-
    StaticAbility(
        effect=Seq(
            steps=(
                A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                    'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                    'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
                }),
                A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                    'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.MENACE),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                }),
            ),
        ),
        condition=FAtom(
            pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
            count=QBin(
                op=QBinOp.ADD,
                left=QProp(referent='controller', field=QPropField.STARTING_LIFE),
                right=QConst(value=1),
            ),
            quantity=QProp(referent='controller', field=QPropField.LIFE),
        ),
    ),
    # [1] "an additional +5/+5 as long as your life total is at least 10 greater": a second static,
    StaticAbility(
        effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
            'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=5)),
            'target': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
            'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=5)),
        }),
        condition=FAtom(
            pred=FAtomPred.QTY_GE,
            count=QBin(
                op=QBinOp.ADD,
                left=QProp(referent='controller', field=QPropField.STARTING_LIFE),
                right=QConst(value=10),
            ),
            quantity=QProp(referent='controller', field=QPropField.LIFE),
        ),
    ),
    # [2]
    SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE),
]

clauses.clause: As long as your life total is greater than your starting life total, Elenda gets +1/+1 and has menace.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (condition comparison of your LIFE with STARTING_LIFE + N 1)

clauses.clause: Elenda gets an additional +5/+5 as long as your life total is at least 10 greater than your starting life total.
clauses.ir: abilities[1] (condition comparison of your LIFE with STARTING_LIFE + N 10)

mapping.notes: 'Hexproof from instants' is M21 Garruk's Harbinger's HEXPROOF with a Filter param, here TYPE_EQ Instant, judged on the targeting source (legality._hexproof_vetoes_target). 'As long as' is StaticAbility.condition (D22) with comparison of your LIFE with STARTING_LIFE + N 1 and 10 (M21 Speaker of the Heavens' starting-life gate). Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/elenda_one_life_over_the_start_is_5_5.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/elenda_nine_life_over_the_start_is_5_5.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/elenda_ten_life_over_the_start_is_10_10.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/elenda_hexproof_from_instants_only.json. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
